title: Exultent et letentur (Josquin)
desc: Josquin des Prez, Exultent et letentur. 1 voices, each on its own staff. Source: Zacconi 1592. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Jos9914); encoded by Jesse Rodin. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py). Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff. No text in this edition.
